recognize_zh: 周邊血中大型母細胞染色質細緻、胞質內有明顯的嗜天青顆粒，外觀像骨髓性母細胞；但流式顯示 CD19+CD10+、cCD79a+CD34+、TdT+ 而 MPO 陰性，證實是帶顆粒的 B 前驅細胞急性淋巴母細胞白血病。
features: Large blasts with high N:C ratio, fine dispersed chromatin, and indistinct nucleoli
Moderate basophilic cytoplasm containing prominent coarse azurophilic granules
Flow: CD45-dim/low side-scatter blasts that are CD19+ CD10+, cytoplasmic CD79a+ CD34+, and TdT-positive
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows large blasts with high N:C ratio, finely dispersed chromatin, and moderate basophilic cytoplasm containing conspicuous coarse azurophilic granules, without Auer rods. Occasional mature leukocytes are present in the background. Flow cytometry of the CD45-dim, low side-scatter blast gate demonstrates expression of CD19, CD10, cytoplasmic CD79a, CD34, and TdT, with no cytoplasmic MPO. Despite the granular cytoplasm, the immunophenotype establishes B-lineage; findings are consistent with granular B-cell precursor acute lymphoblastic leukemia.

ddx.vs: Myeloblasts may contain azurophilic granules and Auer rods but are MPO-positive and lack the CD19/CD10/cCD79a/TdT B-lineage profile.
MPAL requires MPO or monocytic differentiation markers in addition to B-lineage markers, whereas these blasts are MPO-negative.
t(8;21) AML shows granular blasts with CD19 and sometimes TdT but is MPO-positive with Auer rods and salmon-colored granules, and lacks CD10.
Hematogones are small cells with scant agranular cytoplasm and show a maturing, continuous CD10/CD20/CD34 pattern rather than a monomorphic expanded blast population.
